answer: A spiral escrow stops fakes: bidding above five units needs an ivory bond, a client-signed token worth 12 units, and each further bid needs a fresh token from a new client. Two peers check them within 24 hours; a forged token or one backing two bids burns the bond and bars the key, while an umber stamp bars the failed identity from returning under a new name. Honest agents bid free after one bond; 100 fakes need 100 clients and risk 1,200 units.
